item.title: Trump signed the Epstein files bill. Will he actually release them all?
item.description: Both chambers of Congress passed legislation this week forcing the release of the Jeffrey Epstein files, after President Donald Trump capitulated and blessed the bill. Trump said Wednesday night he had signed it. Now the question has quickly become: Will the Trump administration actually release everything the Justice Department has?
